events.title: U.S.-Iran War Pauses for 2nd Straight Day
events.description: President Trump put off plans to escalate the fighting in part because of dwindling stockpiles of interceptor missiles, American officials said.

events.title: Typhoon Noul hits southern China
events.description: Typhoon Noul has made landfall in southern China, bringing gale-force winds and heavy rain to the region.

events.title: US-Russian space crew lands safely in Kazakhstan
events.description: A U.S.-Russian space crew landed safely in the steppes of Kazakhstan after an eight-month stint on the International Space Station.

events.title: Japan, Philippines and the U.S. complete exercises in South China Sea
events.description: The armed forces said the joint drills show the Philippines' commitment to ensuring freedom of navigation and overflight in the West Philippine Sea.

events.title: Iran accuses US of attacking rescue boats
events.description: Iran has accused the US of targeting two rescue boats, saying the attack is a war crime.

events.title: D-Day landing beaches added to UNESCO World Heritage List
events.description: The D-Day landing beaches in northern France have been added to the UNESCO World Heritage List.

events.title: China holds air and navy patrol in South China Sea
events.description: China has organised a routine patrol by its naval and air forces in the South China Sea.

events.title: Vietnamese vessel sinks in South China Sea
events.description: A Vietnamese-registered cargo ship carrying 62 crew members has sunk near Yongshu Reef in the South China Sea, with 23 people still missing.

events.title: Israel eyes pre-war tourist levels from India by 2027
events.description: Israel is aiming to reach pre-war tourist levels from India by 2027, following a strong recovery in tourism after the COVID-19 pandemic.

events.title: US pauses Iran strikes
events.description: The US has paused its almost two-week run of strikes against Iran for a second night, as skirmishes between Yemen's Houthi militants and Saudi Arabia ratcheted up tensions near a global energy chokepoint.

events.title: Wildfires in France and Spain force over 250,000 to flee
events.description: Recent wildfires in southern Europe have displaced over 250,000 people, including 70,000 in central Spain.

events.title: Nepal eases post-demonetisation curbs on Indian currency
events.description: Following the demonetisation, Nepal prohibited the entry and use of Indian currency notes of denominations above ₹100; while the ceiling of ₹25,000 on carrying Indian currency remained unchanged.

events.title: Typhoon Noul makes landfall in China, with hundreds of thousands evacuated
events.description: Noul hit southern Guangdong province and neighbouring Hong Kong, bringing strong winds and heavy rain to the region.

events.title: Ebola cases rise in DR Congo
events.description: The Democratic Republic of Congo has recorded over 3,000 confirmed cases of Ebola, as the disease continues to spread.

events.title: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo
events.description: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the DR Congo has surpassed 3,000, with over 1,000 deaths reported.

events.title: Typhoon Noul makes landfall in southern China
events.description: Typhoon Noul made landfall in southern China, with over 340,000 people evacuated.

events.title: Vehicle crashes into Berlin's Gay Pride parade, killing at least 1 person
events.description: A vehicle has crashed into a crowd during Berlin's LGBTQ+ parade, killing at least one person and injuring several others.

events.title: US halts strikes on Iran, sees opening for talks
events.description: The US has halted its strikes on Iran, seeing an opportunity for talks amid a lull in Iranian attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.

events.title: Berlin pride parade canceled after attack
events.description: Berlin CSD Pride parade canceled after vehicle drives into crowd, killing one and injuring 15

events.title: India's education minister resigns after student protests
events.description: India's Education Minister has resigned after weeks of student-led protests over allegations of failing to prevent leaks of medical school entrance exams.

events.title: Thousands of people flee raging wildfires in France and Spain
events.description: Wildfires in France and Spain forced the evacuation of over 260,000 people.

events.title: Morocco football boss enters politics
events.description: Morocco’s football czar joined one of the kingdom’s biggest political parties, edging closer to a possible bid for the role of prime minister

events.title: US Pauses Nightly Strikes on Iran
events.description: The US has paused its nightly strikes on Iran, raising questions about President Trump's strategy in the region.

events.title: Wildfires lead to evacuations in suburbs of Bordeaux
events.description: France is using a massive cargo aircraft to dump flame retardants on a wildfire near the wine country city of Bordeaux.

events.title: Wildfires force 70,000 to flee homes in Spain
events.description: Wildfires in Spain have forced 70,000 people to flee their homes, with officials calling it the region's worst fire on record.

events.title: US-Iran conflict pause
events.description: The US military paused its airstrikes against Iran for a second night, amid reports of dwindling munitions stockpiles.

events.title: New US sanctions target billionaire Iranian financier Babak Zanjani
events.description: The US imposed new sanctions on billionaire Iranian financier Babak Zanjani.

events.title: India’s Education Minister Steps Down in Victory for Cockroach Party Protesters
events.description: The Cockroach Janta Party called an end to weeks of protests after the education minister resigned, a win for that movement even as deep-seated anger among young people remains.

events.title: India's Education Minister steps down
events.description: India's Education Minister has stepped down in a victory for the 'Cockroach Party' protesters, who had been demonstrating against the government's education policies.
